exclusion.method: scan cohort/holdout/split/prereg/comparison/LOO JSON and JSONL evidence for explicit task IDs and match input-only task signatures; canonicalize zero-padding only for conservative exclusion; explicitly include the 2026-10-29 VARC and HDS action-gate cohorts

cohort.selection: sort eligible one-test training tasks by SHA256(seed + NUL + task_id), take first 200; first 100 discovery, next 100 confirmatory
cohort.exposure_status: exposure_unknown; prior model/module exposure cannot be fully established

labels.scorer_map_creation: after frozen predictions only; kept in Temp outside runtime

hypothesis: The prior HDS action-gate change produced zero candidate-pair coverage and byte-identical output. The measured unresolved rate is high, but prior diagnostics did not score each generated family candidate independently. This two-stage audit distinguishes candidate generation failure from correct-but-unselected candidates.
planned_method: Run the unmodified baseline in default non-aggregate mode while a diagnostic-only sidecar records generic candidate family/grid outputs without changing submitted attempts. Freeze both 100-task outputs. Score only discovery after its freeze. If a correct candidate was generated but not selected, implement one generic train-evidence-based second-attempt selection change; otherwise implement one general candidate-generation change from train examples. Keep confirmatory labels sealed until baseline and candidate confirm outputs are both frozen.
candidate_scope: diagnostic/selection/generation code in a detached temporary worktree; no problem ID, filename, hash, answer-map, or test-output branch; no changes to protected files
adoption_gate: confirmatory pass_at_2 net gain > 0 on 100 grids, valid schema, no material regression, reproducible identical-input run; otherwise do not adopt or submit
